user.title: Configure PC Boot Selector
user.description: Set up a new PC to manage its boot selection files.

os_entry.title: Add Boot Entry
os_entry.description:
Add an operating system option for this PC.

**How to retrieve this info:**
* **GRUB Entry ID**: Run this command on the client PC to list entry IDs:
  `grep -E "submenu|menuentry" /boot/grub/grub.cfg` (look for the string after `$menuentry_id_option`)
* **Partition UUIDs/GUIDs (Limine)**: Run `blkid` or `lsblk -o NAME,UUID,PARTUUID` to find the filesystem UUIDs.

**Limine Entry Config Example (Windows):**
```ini
protocol: efi_chainload
image_path: guid(2E39665E-E798-4C29-A9EF-A28E3F248290):/efi/Microsoft/Boot/bootmgfw.efi
```

**Limine Entry Config Example (Linux):**
```ini
protocol: linux
path: boot():/2adf31daa51541fcb0ceb8476625a2b1/linux-cachyos/vmlinuz-linux-cachyos
module_path: boot():/2adf31daa51541fcb0ceb8476625a2b1/linux-cachyos/initramfs-linux-cachyos
cmdline: quiet nowatchdog splash rw rootflags=subvol=/@ root=UUID=a7b6cf2d-4171-4fcb-9d29-83c7eafd4703
```

instructions.title: Client Setup Instructions
instructions.description:
Your PC Boot Selector configuration files will be available publicly at:
* **Limine Config**: `{limine_url}`
* **GRUB Config**: `{grub_url}`
* **BIOS Config**: `{bios_url}`
* **OS Selection**: `{os_url}`

---

### 🖥️ Client Setup Instructions

Configure your client PC to load these remote configurations:

#### 1. Limine Setup
Add a script to your startup/shutdown or a cronjob to fetch the Limine configuration from Home Assistant:
```bash
wget -O /boot/limine.conf {limine_url}
```

#### 2. BIOS / UEFI Setup
Fetch `{bios_url}` and execute `efibootmgr -n "$BOOT_NEXT"` or `efibootmgr -o "$BOOT_ORDER"`.

#### 3. GRUB Setup

**Option A: Load directly over network (Recommended)**
If your GRUB has network support enabled, add this to `/boot/grub/custom.cfg` or `/etc/grub.d/40_custom`:
```grub
insmod efinet
insmod http
net_dhcp
if [ -s {grub_http_url} ]; then
    source {grub_http_url}
fi
```

**Option B: Download configuration file**
Alternatively, configure a startup script or service to fetch the configuration:
```bash
wget -O /boot/grub/remote_grub.cfg {grub_url}
```
And make sure `/boot/grub/grub.cfg` includes `/boot/grub/remote_grub.cfg`.
